dataset_summary.official_source_statement: The NVIDIA PhysicalAI-SmartSpaces benchmark contains mixed provenance, including synthetic scenes generated via Omniverse and Cosmos Transfer, and real-world test captures (Warehouse_026 and Warehouse_027).

Warehouse_026.official_source_statement: Warehouse_026 is a real-world test capture released by NVIDIA as part of MTMC_Tracking_2026 on 2026-06-04.
Warehouse_026.calibration_documentation_note: The available project evidence does not independently establish the physical surveying methodology or field measurement uncertainty underlying the supplied calibration.
Warehouse_026.camera_pitch_generalization_note: Across the 11 cameras analyzed in Warehouse_026 and Warehouse_027, the optical-axis depression angles derived from the supplied calibration were within the observed range of 20.56°-35.69°. This observation is limited to the two benchmark scenes and must not be generalized to industrial warehouses as a whole.
Warehouse_026.model_h_reason: Model H formal coverage remains unestablished because the physical lux telemetry required by the illumination-dependent component is not available in the released evaluation package.
